title: Direct Sampling Methods for Inverse Interface Problems
summary: This work investigates two types of inverse interface problems in scenarios where only very limited Cauchy data is available. These problems are associated with the Laplace equation featuring a Robin-type flux jump across an internal interface. The first problem focuses on reconstructing the location of cracks along a known interface using Cauchy data measured on the outer boundary. The second problem involves determining the location of an unknown interface based on Cauchy data from the outer boundary.
